name: Exceptional Servant
description: A type of faerie related to the mentor that takes an adolescent on an adventure, leaving them with excellent prospects, then feeds on the vitality of the family.

name: Centaur
description: Faerie composite of horse and human that acts as a mentor guiding the young hero to adulthood; modern hippocentaurs are faerie duplicates of the ancient centaurs.

name: Nuckalevee
description: Irish faerie like a flayed centaur that lairs in the sea and forages for human victims ashore; its breath causes plague and it fears fresh water.

name: Faerie Rival
description: A faerie given form by a character's emotionally charged injury, which must be overcome for the character to claim his birthright or adult role.

name: Master of Skills
description: Faeries that seek out mortals at the peak of their profession to raise them up or cast them down, having the disputed Ability as a Pretense of at least 9.

name: Fachan
description: One-eyed, one-armed, one-legged faerie of distant lochs and valleys in Ireland and Scotland that hates humans and fights with club or poisoned flail.

name: Fer Caille
description: An Irish fachan-like creature that acts as a faerie herdsman and is accompanied by a hag.

name: Direach
description: A gigantic version of the Fachan found in the Scottish Highlands.

name: Faerie Knight
description: Faerie in the role of a knight, clad in silver leaves of metal, that seeks defeat by humans to gain combat Pretenses and is bound by chivalry.

name: The Fatae
description: Faeries who humble women who boast of their weaving.

name: Selkie
description: Human-shaped faeries living beneath the waters who change into seal shape; if their seal skins are stolen they may be forced to become spouses.

name: Barking Beast
description: Faerie beast that lives to be hunted, with the body of a leopard and a baying of hounds from its belly; the greatest test of a hunter's skill.

name: Zlatorog
description: White chamois with golden horns on Mount Triglav in Slovenia that tricks hunters into falling over precipices and heals by eating the red flower grown from its blood.

name: Psychopomp
description: A faerie that leads the spirits of the dead to an afterlife, a role of Hermes in classical times, now rare because of the Dominion.

name: Valkyrie
description: Shield maidens or crones of the Norse pantheon riding wolves above battlefields who choose the worthy dead to become einherjar; encountered by magi in Arcadia.

name: Wolf Mount
description: Horse-sized wolf made of a Valkyrie's glamour, sharing her Might pool and flying when she does.

name: Einherjar
description: Spiritual warriors chosen by the Valkyries, awaiting Ragnarok.

name: Returned Dead
description: Faeries that are, or pretend to be, humans who died and return, often believing they died at an unnatural time.

name: Aoroi
description: The summonable restless dead of ancient Greece, waiting on the worldly side of the Styx; important for divination by the chthonic cult that led to Houses Tytalus and Tremere.

name: Rusalka
description: A type of water nymph, returned dead who come back so their tragedy can be replayed.

name: Ancestral Spirit
description: Faeries believing themselves the ancestor of all people within a family, taking on attributes from the family's history.

name: Banshee
description: Irish faerie and ghost of a woman who sings the death lament for her descendants and grants a wish to anyone claiming to be her foster child.

name: Bean Nighe
description: Washerwoman faerie of Scotland and Ireland seen washing the bloody clothes of one soon to die.

name: Tomte
description: Powerful Scandinavian brownie believing itself the spirit of the person who cleared the land on which the farm stands; aids fertility and cares for horses.

name: Black Faced Hermes
description: Faerie that comes down the chimney to take away unnatural children, abducting the Gifted and leaving them at covenant doors.

name: The Mournful Maga
description: A faerie that apprentices face while growing up.

name: The Seducer
description: Faerie that meets an apprentice before the Gauntlet, tempting him with a life of social acceptance and domesticity.

name: Ravagers
description: Faeries that hunt magi seeking their longevity formula.

name: The Retiarius
description: Faerie that chases potential familiars with his nets to force them to fight in faerie arenas.

name: Master of Challenges
description: Creature tormenting magi deep in Arcadia that sometimes claims to be Tytalus, jailer of imprisoned Giants and Titans.

name: Titans
description: Magic creatures imprisoned in the Faerie Lands since the Titanomachy, held by terrible faerie guardians.

name: Giant
description: Creature type; Magic giants are imprisoned in Arcadia since the Gigantomachy, and most faerie courts are guarded by creatures designed as giants.

name: Brownie
description: Domestic faeries like shaggy foot-tall men, often nude, that do household work and stop serving if given clothes.

name: Boggart
description: English trickster spirit causing havoc in the home; a brownie that has decided to be malicious.

name: Portune
description: Tiny brownie-like faerie, half the size of a thumb, that roasts frogs on the fire while humans sleep.

name: Ellyon
description: Welsh brownie-like faeries that vanish forever if they learn they are being spied upon.

name: Heinzelmännchen
description: German brownie-like creatures resembling dwarfs; every house in Cologne once had one until a curious housewife broke their taboo.

name: Domovoi
description: Slavic brownie living beneath the threshold or stove, a hairy little man with tail and horns who predicts the future.

name: Kikimora
description: Wife of the domovoi who helps with chickens and spinning; seeing her spin is a presentiment of death.

name: Feoderee
description: The most physically imposing brownie, of the Isle of Man; a courtly faerie cursed to become a giant hairy monster.

name: Ùruisg
description: Tiny satyr of Scotland that serves as a brownie, with a taste for dairy products and dairymaids.

name: Courtly Faeries
description: Faeries gathering in large courts that mimic human centers of power, ruled by monarchs and served by gentry, adopting human etiquette.

name: Faerie Monarch
description: Ruler of a faerie court; the most powerful have Faerie Might around 60 and Penetration to challenge senior magi.

name: White Lady
description: Powerful water-linked courtly faerie monarchs of Normandy, claiming to be nine Celtic sorceress princesses; steeped in Druid lore, some supported House Diedne.

name: Faerie Noble
description: Faeries serving as monarchs of lesser courts or principal agents of great monarchs or pagan gods.

name: The Privy Counselor
description: Faerie noble trickster and saboteur sent by an angered monarch against a covenant, posing as a young nobleman.

name: Sir Excelsis
description: The most powerful faerie knight and champion of the White Lady's kingdom, clad in scaled armor of metal fern fronds with a burning fern motif.

name: Faerie Horse
description: Faerie mount, sometimes constructed from a knight's own glamour so it flies when he does.

name: Mimic Dogs
description: Creatures described by Roman writers that could be taught to repeat human actions; probably servant faeries destroyed by the Dominion.

name: Sprite
description: Tiny humanoid courtly faeries with bows used as envoys and saboteurs, attacking in swarms.

name: Courts of Summer and Winter
description: Seasonal faerie courts that fight battles on the Equinoxes, summer and winter defeating one another in turn.

name: Cailleach Bheur
description: The blue hag of Ireland and Scotland representing winter, guardian of streams and wells, who spreads her plaid over the land until summer.

name: Południca
description: Noon faerie appearing as maiden or crone with a scythe, who questions farmhands and strikes them with heatstroke if they fail.

name: Kallikantzaroi
description: Small Greek faeries living under the Earth sawing at the World Tree, allowed on the surface from Christmas until Epiphany.

name: Jolarsveniar
description: Norwegian faeries drawn to Christmas celebrations.

name: Trows
description: Faeries of the Shetland Islands drawn to Christmas celebrations.

name: Drekavac
description: Serbian faerie drawn to Christmas celebrations.

name: Faerie Hound
description: Huge faerie dogs haunting roads of Mythic Europe that terrify and kill travelers; also the hunting hounds of the courtly fae.

name: Aufhocker
description: German faerie hound variant that acts as a kelpie, clinging to foes with its adhere power while goring them.

name: Kludie
description: Belgian, most powerful faerie hound variant, taking monstrous dog, cat, bat, horse or frog forms, preceded by blue flames.

name: Kelpie
description: Pony-like water horse faerie that lures riders onto its back and plunges into the nearest lake.

name: Grant
description: Scottish faerie horse walking on its back legs that appears just before important buildings catch fire.

name: Licho
description: One-eyed old woman faerie personifying ill-fortune, who clings to victims and tricks them into self-harm.

name: Donestre
description: Lion-headed human faerie using Faerie Speech to lure travelers off roads to be eaten, then weeping beside their heads.

name: Merfolk
description: Faeries human from the waist up living in clans beneath the waters where fishing is good; some gain their tails by magical red caps.

name: Abgal
description: Merfolk, possibly aligned with Magic, who tutored the earliest humans; modern mermen may be degenerate abgals.

name: Gigantic Sovereigns
description: The increasingly large rulers of the merfolk.

name: Havfrue
description: Mermaid whose sighting warns of storms; herds white cattle on terrestrial grass during fogs.

name: Hakennman
description: Merman with the body and tail of a fish and a human torso rising from the front.

name: Icthyocentaur
description: Creature with human torso and head, fish or dolphin tail, and horse front legs.

name: Selkie King
description: Powerful ruler of the selkies, who comes ashore to seek brides and can raise storms when selkie blood is spilled.

name: Roane
description: Smaller, less bloodthirsty Highland version of the selkie.

name: Seal
description: Mundane animal whose statistics serve as the alternate form of a selkie.

name: Fool's Fire
description: Tiny flickering faerie lights, also called will o' the wisps, that guide lost travelers into dangerous marsh terrain.

name: Nymph
description: Faeries that guard rivers and wells; the White Ladies range down to lesser nymphs of wells.

name: Great Lezi
description: Slavic Forest Lord who can take any plant or animal shape and size, commanding woodland animals, especially wolves.

name: Lezi
description: The more-common lezi, a form of faun.

name: Basajaun
description: Gigantic red-furred fauns of the Basque country who became agricultural faeries.

name: Faun
description: Rugged horned, goat-legged wild men embodying masculinity and forest secrecy, who play wild music and create endless wine.

name: Satyr
description: Smaller, cowardly faun-like faeries with donkey ears and horse tails, notorious for sexual violence.

name: Glastig
description: Scottish faerie, the Green Maiden, an attractive blonde woman hiding goat limbs under a green dress.

name: Iopontes
description: Faun-like creatures with the lower parts of horses.

name: Panes
description: Satyrs with goat legs and tails.

name: Satyriskoi
description: Child-satyrs.

name: Seilenoi
description: Aged, highly cognizant satyrs from ancient times, treated as fathers by modern satyrs.

name: Tityroi
description: Satyrs that play magical shepherd's pipes.

name: Koerakoonlane
description: Dog-human hybrid faeries of the frozen north who raid settlements on dog sleds to take slaves.

name: Hemicynes
description: Peaceful dog-headed people from the far north in western European folklore.

name: Naval Koerakoonlased
description: Peaceful farming koerakoonlased on an island found by Kalevipoeg, who became fishers.

name: Dwarf
description: Small bearded subterranean faeries guarding the entrances to the earth in caves, barrows and mines, and skilled smiths.

name: Gnome
description: Subterranean version of the small faeries.

name: Goblin
description: Subterranean version of the small faeries.

name: Cerberus
description: Guardian of the gate of Hades, whose statues guarded Roman cave taverns.

name: Galconer
description: Faerie whose statistics are used for the human form of seducing kelpies.

name: Minor Demon of Pride
description: Demon attracted to a boy manipulated by a faerie queen in a story seed.

name: Tuatha de Danu
description: The courtly faeries of Ireland, children of Danu.

name: Lapiths
description: Ancient people of Thessaly who fought the original centaurs.

name: Mystery Cults
description: Cults which have faeries guarding their secrets.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The proudly Roman order of magi, disliked by the White Ladies.

name: Cheiron
description: A centaur who mentored Herakles and became the constellation Centaurus; a powerful astrological spirit aligned to Magic.

name: Herakles
description: Ancient hero mentored by Cheiron.

name: Hermes
description: Classical god whose role included that of psychopomp.

name: Tytalus
description: Founder figure whom the Master of Challenges sometimes claims to be.

name: Brigid
description: Goddess who in ancient times often held summer's power as the Cailleach Bheur's rival.

name: Danu
description: The most powerful river goddess of pagan Europe, of the Danube and Don, mother of the Tuatha de Danu; changed Liban into a mermaid.

name: Liban
description: Irish woman changed into a mermaid by Danu who lived 300 years, was baptised, and entered Heaven as a Holy Virgin.

name: Saint Thaddeus
description: Patron of penitent thieves whose sacred places ward the Privy Counselor.

name: Kalevipoeg
description: Hero who sailed toward the Underworld and found an island of peaceful koerakoonlased.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House descended from the chthonic cult that called on the aoroi.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House descended from the chthonic cult that called on the aoroi.

name: House Diedne
description: House supported by some White Ladies in the Schism.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal where 'White Lady' is a euphemism for faeries.

name: Arcadia
description: The deep faerie lands, where Valkyries, giants and titans and the Master of Challenges are found.

name: Thessaly
description: Ancient region where the original centaurs fought the Lapiths.

name: Mount Triglav
description: Mountain in Slovenia home of the Zlatorog.

name: Valhalla
description: Norse hall where Valkyries act as serving maids.

name: Styx
description: River of the dead on whose worldly side the aoroi wait.

name: Scandinavia
description: Northern lands of the Valkyries' ancient places of power and the tomte.

name: Ireland
description: Home of fachans, banshees, sidhe; ancient Irish claimed Arcadia began seven waves from Ireland.

name: Scotland
description: Home of fachans, the bean nighe, the ùruisg and the Cailleach Bheur.

name: Scottish Highlands
description: Region of the Direach and the roane.

name: Cologne
description: City where every house once had a heinzelmännchen.

name: Isle of Man
description: Home of the Feoderee.

name: Normandy
description: Region of the White Ladies, once inhabited by Celtic tribes.

name: Shetland Islands
description: Home of the trows.

name: Basque Country
description: Region in Iberia home of the Basajauns.

name: Palace of the Selkie King
description: Undersea palace of the selkie king, possibly thatched with brides' hair.

name: World Tree
description: Tree beneath the Earth that the kallikantzaroi saw at each year.

name: Hades
description: Underworld whose gate Cerberus guards.

name: Faerie Lands
description: Lands where giants and titans are imprisoned; described as a ring between Dominion and wilderness.

name: Faerie Realm
description: The realm of faeries, beings made of rules and roles that feed on human vitality.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm to which the original centaurs, Cheiron, abgals and giants are aligned.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm to which some later barking beasts are aligned.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine's presence in human lands, which has made psychopomps rare and against which many faeries have wards.

name: Faerie Might
description: Measure of a faerie's power; around 60 needed to challenge senior magi.

name: Pretense
description: Faerie equivalent of Abilities, improved e.g. by losing to characters.

name: Glamour
description: Faerie substance from which knights' horses, wolf mounts and illusions are made.

name: Intricacy Points
description: Points spent to reduce cost or improve Initiative/Penetration of faerie powers.

name: Vitality
description: Human emotional energy on which faeries feed.

name: Cognizance
description: A faerie's degree of awareness of and ability to change its role.

name: Faerie Role
description: The story role a faerie fulfils and cannot easily change.

name: Parma Magica
description: Magi's magical defense which faerie monarchs need Penetration to overcome.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant ward the Privy Counselor cannot cross.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical substance carried by faeries.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance shared by knights with their glamour mounts.

name: Gauntlet
description: Test ending apprenticeship, before which the Seducer appears.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Formula that the Ravagers hunt magi for.

name: Familiar
description: Magi's bonded animal; the Retiarius hunts potential familiars.

name: Apprentice
description: Gifted child taken for Hermetic training.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent; Black Faced Hermes abducts the Gifted.

name: Covenant
description: Magi's community, targeted by the Privy Counselor.

name: Archmagus
description: Senior magi who speak of faeries deep in Arcadia.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link used for Penetration.

name: Schism War
description: Conflict in which some White Ladies supported House Diedne.

name: Titanomachy
description: Ancient war after which Titans were imprisoned in the Faerie Lands.

name: Gigantomachy
description: Ancient war after which Giants were imprisoned in the Faerie Lands.

name: Ragnarok
description: Norse end-times for which the einherjar wait.

name: Druid Lore
description: Lore in which the White Ladies are steeped.

name: Life Stages
description: Human and Hermetic stages whose borders faeries guard.

name: Thresholds
description: Borders of life, social class, time and space that faeries inhabit.

name: Crossroads
description: Places of faerie power where two borders cross.

name: Epiphany
description: Feast ending the kallikantzaroi's time on the surface, with the Blessing of the Waters.

name: Faerie Court
description: Group of courtly faeries around a monarch with a unifying motif.

name: Threshold Guardian
description: Faerie role controlling access to Faerieland.

name: Hermetic Magus
description: Hermetic magi study faeries and are the targets of many.

name: Social Interaction Virtue or Flaw
description: Required for faeries converted to player characters.
